results.answer_en: Guardrails are the checks around the model, before and after it. Before: validate input, catch injection, strip personal data, limit scope. results.transcript: How do you prevent an agent from looping forever?
results.match_question: How do you prevent an agent from looping forever?
results.answer_en: Hard caps in code, not in the prompt. Max steps, max tokens, max wall-clock time, max cost.
